Since you clicked…

A few proud moments.

If you’ve made it to this page, I’m taking that as permission to be a little proud. These awards mean a lot to me. On a difficult research day, they remind me to keep going.

2025–2026

Wilson Bicentennial Graduate Fellowship

University of Virginia
Competitive endowed fellowship awarded annually to one ECE graduate student for outstanding research.

A very welcome vote of confidence for the next experiment.

2025

First place, Electrical Engineering poster presentation

UVA Engineering Research Symposium
Recognized my research on laser-assisted silver recovery and AI-driven process automation.

The poster rearranging paid off.

2025

Second place, invited speaker presentation

UVA Engineering Research Symposium
For my invited oral presentation on doctoral research in laser processing and photovoltaics.

A good reason to keep practicing the short explanation.

2025

UPLAMP travel award

Vilnius, Lithuania
Travel support to present research at the international summer school on ultrashort-pulse laser materials processing.

Learning about lasers came with a change of scenery.

2023 & 2024

Best Student Presentation Award finalist

50th & 52nd IEEE PVSC
Selected for the oral-presentation competition, recognizing research quality and my contribution as a student.

Two conferences. Plenty of practice explaining the experiment.

2024

NSF-supported travel award

ANGEL-7 · Charlottesville, Virginia
Conference and tutorial support for work on laser-based nanoparticle generation and excitation in liquids.

More questions came home with me.

2019–2022

Institute Fellowship

IIT Delhi
Institute-supported fellowship for experimental physics and materials research in the Department of Physics.

Time and support to keep learning by doing.

2018

Merit-cum-Means Scholarship

IIT Ropar
Scholarship recognizing academic merit and providing financial support during my MSc Physics program.

A little support can make a very big difference.

2016

University Second Rank & Gold Medal in Computer Science

Rani Channamma University
Graduated with 94.97%, ranked second in the university, and was recognized as the Computer Science subject topper.

An early milestone that still means a lot.

None of this happened alone. I’m grateful to the teachers, mentors, collaborators, and family who helped me get here.

Mahantesh Khetri

Charlottesville, Virginia.
Usually somewhere between a question and an experiment.
